integrity: Analytic proof covers all n at least 3; an exact-rational enumerator checks n up to 8 and numerical asymptotics are corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: Uniform recursive trees only; ordinary uniform-tree-first leaf sampling is distinguished from size-biased leaf sampling; asymptotic is annealed. Full text of Elizalde (2024) unavailable for complete priority comparison.
title: Sharp total-variation separation of vertex and leaf depths in uniform recursive trees
